purpose: Per-session execution goal. Copy this file to goal.template.json at session start, set the current goal, and keep graders/validation/agent routing current when files or commands change.
goal: Track — iOS Ledger Honesty: close functional pending controls, macOS/iOS parity (create community, auth, accessibility), and visual-parity-only rows.

design_references.purpose: Single source of truth for Like-minded visual language, copy tone, interaction principles, and iOS/macOS design rules.
usage: Before iOS native UI work, consult DESIGN.md and the relevant screen-range images in mockups/ios/.
Before macOS native UI work, consult DESIGN.md and the relevant screen-range images in mockups/macos/.
Skip mockups for backend-only, validation-only, or non-visual changes.

local_simulator.purpose: Build, install, and launch the simulator app; prove fresh auth gate, empty-dev-db Profile onboarding, and DEBUG signed-in backend placement tabs.
reuse_when: Local API auth or MVP placement routes change.

external_preflight.purpose: Verify real Render, Neon, Apple, LiveKit, TestFlight, and manual proof recorded in release/testflight-evidence.json.

does_not_prove: Real spoken audio creating persisted profile and placement.

external_preflight.next_agent_action: Treat as a later release gate after repo-owned hardening is complete; ask the user to fill release/testflight-evidence.json only when external setup and device proof are actually ready.

release_gate.external_preflight: Run npm run verify:external-preflight only after Render, Neon, Apple Developer, App Store Connect/TestFlight, and manual device proof are ready.

agent_guardrails: Lazy context: goal:next + narrowest lane command first; stop when answered. Do not preload GOAL.md, full PROGRESS, mockups, or source trees for status questions.
Lazy authoring: edit control owners (validation JSON, PROGRESS track, workflow command table) — do not add parallel docs or status tables.
Before claiming phase/track/goal complete, run npm run verify:ledger-progress. Actionable fail/pending/stale-blocked controls need unchecked PROGRESS owners; JSON is sole control-status owner.
When a control is fail or stub, add or keep an unchecked PROGRESS item in the same session.

deterministic_graders.name: node_syntax
deterministic_graders.proves: JavaScript entrypoints and grader scripts parse.

deterministic_graders.name: mvp_backend_contract
deterministic_graders.proves: Auth-gated discovery, persisted profile/placement, placement action, feedback, meetings RSVP/scheduling, LiveKit token generation, notifications, community members, soulmate preferences, and cross-user isolation work locally.

deterministic_graders.name: release_static_config
deterministic_graders.proves: TestFlight-critical bundle id, entitlements, API base URL, LiveKit env vars, Render env, and privacy-policy files are configured.

deterministic_graders.name: goal_contract
deterministic_graders.proves: goal.json and goal.template.json contain the current grader, validation, rubric, and agent routing contract.

deterministic_graders.name: ledger_progress_ownership
deterministic_graders.proves: Every actionable fail/pending/stale-blocked control in validation/{ios,macos}/*.json has an unchecked PROGRESS.md owner track item.

deterministic_graders.name: repo_docs_lint
deterministic_graders.proves: Repo docs follow the local workflow documentation contract.

deterministic_graders.name: validation_data_lifecycle
deterministic_graders.proves: Validation API can attach a separate local database and seed deterministic backend data for profile, circles, communities, meetings, soulmate, and chat flows.

deterministic_graders.name: local_simulator_validation
deterministic_graders.proves: XcodeGen project builds, installs, launches fresh auth gate, proves empty-dev-db Profile onboarding, then enters the DEBUG signed-in Meet/Circles/Communities/Profile app through backend dev auth.

preferred_agent.name: validation-release
preferred_agent.use_when: Simulator or build verification is read-heavy, screenshot-based, or likely to produce long logs.

checks: Fresh install shows Sign in with Apple gate, not old prototype tabs.
Empty dev DB sign-in can route to Profile onboarding with no pre-seeded user data.
After DEBUG placement sign-in, tabs are Meet, Circles, Communities, Profile.
Circle detail Leave circle defers placement through backend.
Profile communication read card is display-only without misleading chevron.

subagents.default_policy: Do not create new agents unless repeated work is not already owned by an existing project agent.

allowed.name: validation-release
can_do: summarize failing assertions and likely owner files
cannot_do: edit files unless the main thread assigns a bounded patch

allowed.name: native-app
can_do: bounded SwiftUI/native project fixes after deterministic failure evidence
cannot_do: replace the native project strategy without approval

completion_commit.when: After all required deterministic and local simulator validation passes, and before marking the session goal complete.
must_include: all implementation, validation, doc, and stale-cleanup files changed for the session

done_criteria: All functional iOS controls in validation/ios/*.json are pass/blocked with source-trace or runtime evidence (visual-parity rows may remain pending-mockup-compare).
iOS create-community flow matches macOS POST /v1/communities parity.
npm run verify:ledger-progress passes for iOS functional controls.
Likeminded iOS build and npm run check pass.
Validated session changes committed with goal.json before marking completed.
